تمتنعي (form VIII)
# تَمْتَنِعِي (tamtaniʕī) /tam.ta.ni.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# تُمْتَنَعِي (tumtanaʕī) /tum.ta.na.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
